title.en: An Act to Amend Section Five of Act Numbered Two thousand Five Hundred and Eighty-Nine Entitled "An Act Providing for a Gratuity By Reason of Retirement to Officers and Employees of the Philippine Government Who Have Rendered Satisfactory Service During Six Continuous Years or More, and for Other Purposes," as Amended By Act Numbered three thousand Two Hundred and thirty-three.

text.en:
Section five of Act Numbered Two thousand five hundred and eighty-nine, entitled "An Act
providing for a gratuity by reason of retirement to officers and employees of the Philippine Government who
have rendered satisfactory service during six continuous years or more, and for other purposes," as amended
by Act Numbered Three thousand two hundred and thirty-three, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Section 5. A Person separated or retired under the provisions of this Act may be reappointed to any position
in the Government of the Philippine Islands, but by accepting such reappointment he shall forever waive all
future gratuity payments, pensions or claims under the provisions of this or any other existing Act. Similarly,
a retired person who, under the provisions of this Act, shall have received or discounted the gratuity payments
to which he was entitled shall, upon his reappointment to any position in the Government of the Philippine
Islands, first refund to the government or to the investment fund or bank to payments, which he had assigned
his rights to the gratuity, the total amount of gratuity payments already received or the total discounted value
of all the gratuity payments which he would not yet have received had these been made to him in monthly
installments: Provided, That the respective Department Head may authorize the reappointed officer employee
to pay the sum to be refunded by him in monthly installments equivalent to the sum being paid by the Insular
Government to him or the investment fund or bank, said monthly installments to be deducted from the
monthly pay accruing to him after reappointment, and said monthly deductions to continue until the total
amount of gratuity payments already received or the last monthly installment payable by the Insular
Government to the investment fund or bank shall have been paid in full, the sum deducted from the salaries of
reappointed officers and employees as herein authorized shall accrue as refund to the unappropriated surplus
of the Insular Government: Provided, however, That if the reappointed officer or employee is separated from
the service by reason of death or abolition of his position, before the last monthly installment is refunded, said
employee or his estate shall not be required to refund such amount as may still remain unrefunded upon his
death or abolition of his position."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 5, 1934.
